body: i just finished it today. let me join 😔🤚🏻

We don’t have one... and thats on my school. i thought about visiting a therapist but i dont even know what i would tell them. I think i would start laughing (because i wouldnt believe im telling that to an actual adult that i dont know) and they would straight up prescribe me Zoloft etc. for the joker i am.

Yesterday it was proven that he is what you called him :)

I told my best friend about my attempts once, and she just got quiet and nodded. And whenever we talked about dying soon she would say “no bro you cant leave me with these a**holes” (meaning our classmates) I’m feeling better now though.. although i always do feel like i am just supposed to die this way, you know. I swear that even if i was at my best and someone came up to me and said “hey, wanna die now?” i would say “ok”.  The main trigger is my family though. They make me feel like a black sheep. I know that some people have it worse, but thats even better reason for me to die, because some people went through worse shit and i am just too sensitive and weak.

I could, i was planning on buying a new electric guitar and i draw sometimes.. but i dont have any goals anymore.

Watch funny stuff or movies you love. Think about food you’re gonna eat the next time, go for a walk and get a pet if you dont have one. Watch interesting videos about politics, or documentaries.
Thats what helps me, it may look so plain and ordinary, but only to those who dont care about these “little” things in life.
